svg.aria-label: Same learned model sampled with DDPM and DDIM

g.text: Same trained weights and initial seed. DDIM eta = 0. All axes: -3 to 3. 256 samples each.
Calls are per sample, not walltime. Near-center fraction misses large errors and frequency imbalance.
DDIM 8 saves 87.5% of denoiser calls but has worse symmetric reference distance here.
One development fixture and fixed settings. No retraining, setting search or general sampler ranking.
